traditional_question: Which household use and bedroom layout are supported for this property?
shared_question: Which room-rental use, occupant count and proposed alterations are supported?
evidence_to_request: Property-specific permission records, layout and unresolved conditions

traditional_question: What dated lease or comparable supports whole-home rent and collection assumptions?
shared_question: What dated room evidence supports the host base rates, collection share and turnover assumptions?
evidence_to_request: Dated lease/comparable records; separate assumptions from observed collections

traditional_question: Which management, leasing, maintenance and tenant-paid items does the actual agreement include?
shared_question: Which platform charges, local management, utilities, cleaning and recurring tasks remain owner-paid?
evidence_to_request: Current agreements, payout definitions, written scope and itemized cost sources

traditional_question: What make-ready work, vacancy and leasing cash is required before receipts start?
shared_question: What permissions, conversion, furnishing, installation and lease-up cash is required?
evidence_to_request: Work scopes, quotes, sequence, readiness dates and available liquidity

traditional_question: Who handles leasing, repairs, urgent calls and backup coverage?
shared_question: Who handles room turns, shared-space issues, supplies, repairs and backup coverage?
evidence_to_request: Named accountable roles, written duties, response plan and backup availability

traditional_question: What loan and policy terms apply, and what happens if the planned lease fails?
shared_question: What written loan and policy review covers the proposed use, and what would a return to another use require?
evidence_to_request: Lender and insurer responses, constraints and a separately costed fallback plan
